title: feature-polish-end-of-day-log
content:
Evening jot: quick run-through of PRD polish + follow-ups before tomorrow's sync. 

Top objectives for tomorrow (quick):
- Finalize PRD copy for model routing section (need one-paragraph summary + decision table).
- Lock canary rollout windows with infra (confirm 11am PDT - 2h).
- Send stakeholder summary email after 9am check-in.

PRD edits made (notes for diff + why):
1) Model routing section: reworked 2nd paragraph to call out fallback policy explicitly. Old text vague; new text includes priorities: latency > cost > regional-compatibility. TODO: add explicit example with traffic percentages (see inline bracket).
2) KPI table: replaced "avg latency" with "p95 latency" for external SLOs. Rationale: customer-facing promise should match tail behavior. Need ops to confirm p95 target (asked @Liam).
3) Security subsection: added KMS rotation cadence note and pointer to security playbook. Ask security to verify phrasing (Priya).
4) Rollout steps: collapsed steps 3/4 into single step to reduce ambiguity — added a rollback trigger list (error rate > 1% or latency spike > 80%).

Unresolved phrasing/decisions (to resolve in morning):
- "compatible model variant" definition — are we limiting to same family or any smaller quantized variant? (Ops input needed)
- Canary duration: 2 hours vs 4 hours (tradeoff: speed of detection vs exposure). Ops + SRE preference?
- Metrics: include token-level cost estimate per 1k requests? Finance asked for rough numbers for sales deck.

Stakeholder follow-ups (who, what, by when):
- Liam Chen (SRE): confirm p95 target + schedule for canary infra readiness. (by 10am).
- Priya Nair (Security): quick review of KMS wording + any compliance callouts (by noon).
- Marco (Solutions Eng): validate sample telemetry dashboard widgets in PRD (by EOD tomorrow).
- Sales (cc Sarah): one-paragraph blurb for external-facing launch note (I will draft; need Sarah's edits by Wed).

Launch smoke checklist (minimal to go-live):
[ ] Canary infra green (autoscaler + LB configs)
[ ] Canary run (traffic ramp to 1%)
[ ] Observability hooks live (token breakdown, route traces)
[ ] Alerting configured for rollback triggers
[ ] Config pinned in repo + changelog entry
[ ] Post-launch watch rotation assigned

Quick timeline (tentative):
- 09:00 — Morning sync (confirm owners + smoke checklist)
- 10:30 — SRE pre-canary verification
- 11:00 — Start canary (1% traffic -> monitor for 2h)
- 13:15 — Decision meeting: promote / extend / rollback

Notes to self (scratch):
- Keep PRD diff compact; reviewers hate long diffs late in day.
- Call out the single-source-of-truth for gating: PRD + rollout-config in repo.
- Remember to add an example curl snippet showing fallback behavior under load.

Random friction points we may hit:
- Quantized model availability in region-us-west1 might be limited; plan fallback to hosted variant.
- Cost-estimates often lowball token churn for chat flows; add 15% buffer to early estimates.

Post-mortem hooks (if rollout hits issue):
- Capture earliest failing trace + token counts.
- Quick rollback, then snapshot logs and KV cache state.
- Schedule 1-hour incident review within 48h.

Tomorrow morning priorities (first 30m):
1) Read SRE confirmation email from Liam.
2) Push final PRD edits and ping reviewers.
3) Draft stakeholder summary email (short bullets).

End-of-day thought: this reads like a kitchen-sink but keeping the list here felt faster than juggling multiple docs. If anything blocks, escalate to Marco > Priya > Liam in that order.

-- Ava
